privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.sub: This desktop pet is a personal hobby project.
privacy.desc: DeskBud desktop pet privacy and data collection notes
privacy.intro: DeskBud never collects or uploads your personal information, documents, photos, or window contents.
privacy.p1: The app runs entirely on your local device. By default it requires no network and never uploads any data from your machine.
privacy.p2: If network features are enabled, it only fetches public bubble-quote assets. This is an access-only operation and never sends any local information outward.
privacy.p3: The app does not read, scan, or peek at private files, photos, or documents on your device.
privacy.p4: The app contains no background reporting, behavioral statistics, or user tracking modules.
